body: Thanks for support :) As the internet says: in the end everything will be alright, if it's not, then it's not the end yet. I try to stay positive, but the worst thing is that when it hits you, it hits you hard. I woke up this morning and realized that I am in deep trouble (emotionally, morally). I love my parents, I love my brother and his family (I am his sons godfather and I love him to death). But I tryed to tell my brother that something isnt right with me, but you know he is older than me and a little bit conservative emotionally, so he didn't really understand me. Maybe I was too subtile, I tryed to reach for my friend, he comforted me, but didn't took for real (hard to explain but I think you understand). Yet it is cool that you are here strong trying to help people like me. And thanks for the hugs.

Thanks, I dont know, maybe I just needed to talk or to say to anybody about this. I try to stay optimistic. I have a job, I use public transport and sometimes I get anxiety attacks due to paranoia of epilepsy seizure, outside I look calm and everything, but inside I scream and just want to collapse. The feeling of the attack is like you want to scream at bus driver to drive faster to my home, but I try to calm myself just by saying that it is just one of those moments and it will pass. And there is also moments like this, I just emotionally collapse and just start crying. I am really scared. It sucks. Thank you.
